September 9, 1974 Resolved the DIR comments of Sentember 4 meeting by phone. January 30, 1975 Submitted the Airport Spur Air Quality Report to DNR incorporating all previous comments for their review and further comment including information to satisfy DiR's letter of comment dated October 3, 1973. DIR requested by phone "worst probable "larch 6, 1975 microscale analysis" including one and eight hour concentrations of carbon monoxide. March 20, 1975 DIR requested by memorandum additional information on combining aircraft emissions with automobile emissions. Aircraft activity projections for Mitchell Field to be based on data being developed by the consultant preparing the airport master plan. lay 22, 1975 Transmitted "lotice of Intent" on preferred alternate for review by DNR the Indirect Source Review Agency. This submission included revisions DMR requested in March 6 and 20. June 6, 1975 Received comment on the "lotice of Intent" from DIR requesting further air quality analysis based on improvements in the state of the art and air quality assessment techniques. July 10, 1975 DOT met with DIIR to discuss the changing requirements according to new parameters set forth in Wisconsin Administrative Code NR 154 on Indirect Source Rules, and to meet DIR's latest requirements. September 2, 1975 DOT met with DNR to discuss the "state of the art" in air quality assessment techniques as outlined in EPA's Guidelines for Air Quality Maintenance Planning and Analysis Volume 9: Evaluating Indirect Sources, dated January, 1975. October 23, 1975 Transmitted revised detailed Air Quality Report and Notice of Intent based on EPA's guidelines on Evaluating Indirect
Source Rules.
